definitions.explanation: Moving in an uncontrolled, reckless manner, often referring to vehicles or people acting without restraint.

examples.japanese: {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暴走|ぼうそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The car went out of control.

examples.japanese: {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To put a stop to the rampage.

notes:
{暴走|ぼうそう} describes uncontrolled, reckless movement or behavior — running wild, going berserk, or spiraling out of control.

COMPOUNDS:
- {暴走|ぼうそう}{族|ぞく}: biker gang (motorcycle gang known for reckless driving)
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: reckless driving
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: runaway accident
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: reckless/out-of-control driving

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run wild, to go out of control
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop the rampage
- {暴走|ぼうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯止|はど}め→歯止め：09326_hadome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put a brake on reckless behavior

USAGE:
Used literally for vehicles going out of control, and figuratively for people acting without restraint, emotions running wild, or systems malfunctioning. In modern usage, also describes AI or technology going haywire.

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}→暴走族：23108_bousouzoku⟧ refers to motorcycle gangs that were especially prominent in Japan from the 1970s-90s, known for loud modified bikes and reckless group riding.
